cover.report_type: Interim Report: Seven days before a primary election

_meta.notes: LABEL DISAGREEMENT: the clerk listing files this as the 'June' interim, but the FORM checks 'Seven days before a primary election' - the June 17 / June 19 dated box is not what is marked (this is the older blank, whose interim options are April 5 / seven days before a primary / September 15 / seven days before a general). Typed 'X' selection; neither amendment box marked. Signature 6/17/14, Summary Page header 'Nelson / 06/17/2014', clerk-stamped JUN 17 2014. Every figure reconciles: Column A (1,964.50 + 13,716.74 = 15,681.24; minus 4,877.48 = 10,803.76) and Column B against the April filing (5,808.62 + 13,716.74 = 19,525.36; 3,844.12 + 4,877.48 = 8,721.60).

contributions.detail: exact (13716.74 = 13716.74) against Summary Page line 1 Column A AND against the attachment's own printed 'Total Contributions $13,716.74'. 47 rows. The $1.95 PayPal 'Refund' row is counted POSITIVE - it has to be for the printed total to close, and in-kind rows count too (per the form).

expenditures.detail: exact (4877.48 = 4877.48) against Summary Page line 2 Column A AND against the attachment's own printed 'Total Expenses $4,877.48'. 28 rows.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: THE ONE GATE THAT WOULD NOT CLOSE, and it is the FILER'S arithmetic, not mine. p5+p6 attachment rows sum to 13716.74 = the attachment's printed 'Total Contributions' 13,716.74 - GATE PASSED. p7 attachment rows sum to 4877.48 = printed 'Total Expenses' 4,877.48 - GATE PASSED. BUT the two printed FORM pages disagree with their own attachments: p3 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED' prints $13,674.80 (verified in a 300 dpi crop) and p4 'TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE' prints $4,835.54 (same) - each is EXACTLY $41.94 LOW, and $41.94 is the 4/19/2014 Cowboy Grub row, which appears once on each schedule. The SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE cell is blank on both form pages. Nothing was adjusted: the Summary Page and the attachments agree with each other and with my rows; the two form-page totals are retained here verbatim as the filer's own inconsistency.
itemized.escalation_note: (1) 700 dpi crop of the p5 first-name/last-name columns to settle whether 'Aggrega'/'Utah Sta' were an OCR failure or a real clip - they are HARD-CLIPPED at the spreadsheet column boundary (glyphs cut mid-character), so no resolution recovers them and they are left incomplete. (2)+(3) 300 dpi crops of the p3 and p4 TOTAL cells to confirm the two form-page totals that disagree with the Summary Page. Attachment rows were read from the rotated 250 dpi full pages (crisp born-digital text) and every amount is corroborated by an exact schedule-total closure on both sides, so verified=1.
itemized.notes: PAGE ORDER: 1 cover, 2 Summary Page, 3 Schedule A form (blank grid, 'See Attached' in row 1), 4 Schedule B form (blank grid, 'See Attached'), 5-6 LANDSCAPE Schedule A attachment, 7 LANDSCAPE Schedule B attachment. Pages 5-7 are landscape and were rotated 90 deg CLOCKWISE (PIL rotate(-90)) to read - note this is the OPPOSITE sign from the other landscape filing in this chunk, confirming the brief's warning that the sign is per file. Geometry is converted back to the portrait page as poppler renders it, so each row is a NARROW VERTICAL band. PRIVACY: the county redacted the Complete Mailing Address column on pages 5 and 6 with a solid black bar, so donor_city/donor_state are blank with 'redacted' stated per row; the SINGLE exception is contribution line 1, whose address sits above the bar - only its city (Taylorsville) and state (UT) are kept and the street was discarded at read time. THE ATTACHMENT USES SEPARATE FIRST-NAME AND LAST-NAME COLUMNS and the first-name column is clipped where the text is long, which is why 12 aggregate rows read 'Aggrega Contribution Under $50' and one donor reads 'Utah Sta Organization'; none of these were completed. Cover checks the interim box 'Seven days before a primary election' and is stamped RECEIVED IN OFFICE JUN 17 2014; office 'Salt Lake County District Attorney' - consistent with the chunk label.
